text:
Ava Patel: Heads-up — product is launching a tier migration next Wed that moves a bunch of Sandbox users into the Growth tier. PM thinks we'll see a packaging-driven burst. Can infra run a quick GPU-hour forecast and quota ask?

Ravi Singh: Do we have a rough user conversion number? a % bump helps translate to GPU hours.

Ava Patel: PM sent projections: ~12k baseline GPU-hrs/week for hosted inference across prod pools. Expected incremental demand: 5–9k GPU-hrs/week in the first month, tapering to ~3–4k/wk after 6 weeks. Rough peak concurrency estimate: +30–50% during 14:00–22:00 PT.

Elena Gomez: Note: us-west-1 has limited spare capacity next month because of another partner allocation. If forecast is right we should plan for cross-region routing (us-east / eu-west) or temp Dedicated reservation.

Jon Park: For immediate mitigation we can: 1) raise per-account rate limits for tier-migrated customers 2) enable burst routing to us-east 3) spin up 50 reserved GPUs in Dedicated for 2 weeks. Any preference?

Marta Li: Cost calc quick check: at $1.20/GPU-hr, 8k extra GPU-hrs/wk ≈ $9.6k/wk -> ~$38.4k/mo. If we pick cheaper spot/quantized configs might shave ~25%.

Ravi Singh: Can we model autoscaler behavior? last time a sudden +40% caused batching backlog and latency SLO violations for small requests. We need predicted p50/p95 latency impact.

capacity-bot: Autoscaler sim finished for +50% sustained traffic over 72h: additional 58 GPUs required to keep p95 < 350ms in default routing (95% confidence). Queue depth > 2 for 18% of requests if not scaled. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/capacity-sim/1763007890

Elena Gomez: Given capacity-bot result and us-west constraint, prefer: pre-warm 60 GPUs in us-east and enable model-fallback ribbon to a quantized variant for non-critical customers. Also reduce default tenant concurrency to 6 for first 2 weeks.

Jon Park: Draft rate-limit patch (can we ship as a soft cap?):
```json
PATCH /api/v1/admin/rate_limits
{
  "scope": "tier:migrated-growth",
  "limits": {
    "requests_per_minute": 240,
    "tokens_per_minute": 120000
  },
  "soft": true
}
```

Ava Patel: Nice. PM is OK with soft caps + fallback for first 3 weeks. Action items: @Ravi run updated forecast with regional split + p95 impact, @Elena open Dedicated reservation for 60 GPUs in us-east for 14 days, @Jon prepare soft-cap rollout PR and monitoring playbook, @Marta finalize cost delta and optional spot/quant configs.

Ravi Singh: On it — I'll attach the spreadsheet in this thread within an hour.

Marta Li: I'll run a quick cost sensitivity on quantization + spot and post numbers.

Jon Park: I'll enqueue the PR behind a feature flag and add a circuit-breaker for latency regressions.

Ava Patel: Thanks team. If any of the numbers push above +9k GPU-hrs/wk we reconvene and consider temporary paid capacity buys or customer throttles. :thumbsup:

capacity-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check in 7 days.
